contentBlocks.text: This week you've built every piece of a formal essay. Today: put it all together!

Combine everything from this week: your ਭੂਮਿਕਾ, ਵਿਸ਼ਾ-ਵਸਤੂ, and ਸਿੱਟਾ sentences from Day 2, connected with ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਇਲਾਵਾ and ਅੰਤ ਵਿੱਚ from Day 3. Expand each of your three sentences into a full sentence or two, and write your complete formal ਲੇਖ on your chosen topic, using a clear ਸਿਰਲੇਖ (title) at the top.
You just wrote a complete formal Punjabi essay! Tomorrow we'll review everything from this week.

objectives: Combine this week's structure and transition-word skills into one complete formal essay
Write a complete ਲੇਖ with a title, expanding on Days 1-3's outline
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review this week's structure and transition-word work together.
2. Have the child expand each outline sentence into a fuller sentence or two.
3. Have the child write the complete essay with a ਸਿਰਲੇਖ (title).
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's cumulative review.
differentiationTips: Struggling: it's fine if each part is just one expanded sentence — focus on completing all three connected parts rather than length
Ready for more: ask the child to add one additional supporting detail to their ਵਿਸ਼ਾ-ਵਸਤੂ section
This is the week's synthesis moment — writing a genuinely complete, connected formal essay is the important skill here, not just having the separate pieces
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is an open-ended composition activity — check that the essay includes a title, all three structural parts (ਭੂਮਿਕਾ, ਵਿਸ਼ਾ-ਵਸਤੂ, ਸਿੱਟਾ), and correctly uses at least one of this week's transition words.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Directly addresses this course's formal-writing thread, completing this week's essay-writing sequence before tomorrow's review.

generationData.instructions: Write your complete formal essay with a title.
